info.title: Flick Local API
info.description: Local-first HTTP and WebSocket API for Flick.

property.description: brightness_pct, volume_level, position, percentage or temperature.

verb.description: up, down, on, off, stop, toggle or level_set.

ActionDto.description: Action JSON accepted by API routes.

ActionOutcomeDto.description: Result of testing or dispatching an action.

status.description: sent, ok, error, timeout, stale or suppressed.

device_ref.description: OS device id or file path.

state.description: starting, running, idle, reconnecting, error or stopped.

EngineStatus.description: Engine status shown on the dashboard.

kind.description: static or motion, optional for auto-detect.

HandEvent.description: One hand in the hand stream.

HealthResponse.description: Health check response used by the desktop supervisor.

LatencyBreakdown.description: Latency breakdown stored in the activity log.

duration_s.description: Duration in seconds. Null/omitted pauses until resumed.

ProblemJson.description: RFC 9457 problem response with a stable Flick error code.

allOf.description: Arbitrary JSON setting values keyed by stable setting name.

SettingsDto.description: OpenAPI schema wrapper for settings maps.

target.description: Target object with exactly one entity_id/device_id/area_id.

phase.description: download, verify, selftest, benchmark or shadow.

VerbBinding.description: Verb binding shown for a selected target.

oneOf.description: Client fell behind and must resync through REST.

payload.description: Client fell behind and must resync through REST.

WsServerMessage.description: WebSocket server message. All variants include `ts`.
